criteria.passage: I’d acknowledge the fix note, apologize, and say we still need to verify it worked on the customer’s side.
criteria.rationale: This clearly explains the proposed next action in understandable terms, including acknowledging the note and verifying whether the fix worked.

criteria.passage: I’d explain the next update depends on that confirmation and any follow-up investigation.
criteria.rationale: This sets a justified expectation by tying the next update to customer confirmation and further investigation, without promising an unsupported outcome or timeline.

criteria.passage: I’d ask them to retry the service and send back what they see, and I’d explain the next update depends on that confirmation and any follow-up investigation. I’d keep the ticket open or re-open it and follow up once we have a successful confirmation.
criteria.rationale: This provides an appropriate follow-up mechanism: requesting the customer to retry and report results, keeping the ticket open or re-opened, and following up after confirmation.
